cc:Work.dc:title: Opponent HP Depleted
cc:Work.dc:description: Distribution of all30terminal HP-depletion scores per model; dots are battles and black squares are means. Opus89.58%, Carbon84.47%, Astra81.80%, Neon81.49%, Sol81.76%, Flash70.86%. Each original opponent contributes equally. Healing can reduce depletion. Wins have100%depletion. Vertical jitter does not change exact horizontal scores. These are final states rather than a time-series.
